crossRefs.note: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.
But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.
All those who see me mock me. They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying,
He was despised and rejected by men, a man of suffering and acquainted with disease. He was despised as one from whom…
looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross…
When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges…
Jesus answered, “I don’t have a demon, but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.
The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against Yahweh, and against his Anointed…
Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.

translations.web: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries are all before you.
translations.bsb: You know my reproach, my shame and disgrace. All my adversaries are before You.
translations.kjv: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries
translations.asv: Thou knowest my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonor: Mine adversaries are all before thee.
